notes: B-7115 ran the 52nd to the 56th, all nine on rig 2. The house signed rig 2 off again on the 58th.
The house signed rig 1 off on the 60th. Its block read 20.04 on the 62nd, against 20.66 the last time rig 1 ran, on the 43rd.
B-7122 arrived on the 62nd, ten parts. The first two went on rig 1 and the other eight followed on rig 2.
